selection_rules: Baseline must implement its stated method correctly; an invalid baseline can demonstrate a bug repair, not a superior learning method.
Distinguish changes to representation, learning objective, training schedule, learned-state update, readout priors, runtime optimization, implementation repair, and evaluation repair.
For a learning claim identify the state that actually learned, the training inputs, and genuine before/after measurements.
Compare the same panel and explain training-example overlap, update budget, pretraining cost, restored states, and held-out generalization.
Report useful gains together with observed losses and unknown costs; assess absolute costs as well as percentages.
Do not infer product integration from an experiment implementation or a differently named repair commit.
Use book results that explain the mechanism; generic phrases about фиксированный вход are not evidence of improved learning.
review_mode: Read source, saved results and commit history; do not run fresh model training, inference, builds or tests.
